cities.basis: official transaction-based price index by size class (RVD)
cities.name: Hong Kong (RVD index)

country_attribution: Source: National sources, BIS residential property price database. OECD Analytical house price indicators (OECD.ECO.MPD, DSD_AN_HOUSE_PRICES).

global.method: First principal component of standardised quarterly log real returns since 1990 (EM imputation for gaps); betas from a regression of each country's raw real return on the factor. Exuberance: GSADF (Phillips, Shi, Yu) on log real prices with Monte Carlo critical values; flagged when the backward SADF exceeds its 95% value in the latest quarter.
